title: 八角奏乐亭 Ba Jiao Zou Yue Ting
subtitle: east octagonal music pavilion · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace: position and footprint from the ruin, the plan or a survey, heights read from the plates of the 1780s (research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv). Not a detailed model yet; the figures and their methods are in the Dimensions block.
rows: octagonal music pavilion, two storeys: 8.7 × 8.7 m, eave 9.3 m, ridge 12.5 m
corridor, 9 bays, curved on the plates; a straight run here: 47.9 × 4 m, eave 8.8 m, ridge 9.6 m

searched: No text or drawing names it in 日下旧闻考 j83, the Qianlong poems on Kanripo, Delatour 1803, Malone 1934, the witnesses of 1860, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings.

photos.title: 谐奇趣南面 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 一 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: Printed title; the two octagonal music pavilions and the south pool stand on the plate. Viewer looks north: XY01-01 (west) is on the left, XY01-N01 (east) on the right. Roof behind the west colonnade; arcaded water structure with gate tower at the left edge.
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons

photos.title: 谐奇趣 east wing, colonnade and music pavilion
photos.creator: Ernst Ohlmer
photos.archive: unknown holder of this copy; Ohlmer plates linked to Hildesheim (S89, S90)
photos.why: Commons caption (east wing and east music pavilion); octagonal pavilion and curved arcade as on plate P0041. XY01-N01 is the eastern 八角奏乐亭 on the plan.
photos.licence: Commons: "Public domain"; file tags PD-old-80-1923|deathyear=1927 PD-China
photos.camera_note: Octagonal pavilion at right with the curved colonnade running left to the main block: east wing seen from the south-south-west, about 35 m from XY01-N01. +-20 m, bearing +-20.

photos.title: Fotografija Ruševine knjižnice v Stari poletni palači (album: "Yüen-Ming-Yüen: Ruinen der Bibliothek")
photos.creator: anonymous (holder)
photos.archive: Slovenski etnografski muzej, Skuškova zbirka; portal East Asian Collections in Slovenia
photos.why: Album: "Ruinen der Bibliothek", holder reads 养雀笼. Thick columns round a brick core: same cluster as at the right edge of P0172, and the ground storey of the east music pavilion in P0185. Ground storey clusters of the octagon as P0174 top-left and P0185; right edge of P0172.
photos.attribution: Skuškova zbirka, Slovenski etnografski muzej, CC BY-SA 4.0
photos.visible: ground storey: three clusters of Ionic columns round a brick core

photos.title: Yüan-ming-yüan. Der alte Sommerpalast, von den Verbündeten 1860 zerstört. Ⅰ 2
photos.creator: Alfons von Mumm
photos.archive: Alfons von Mumm, Ein Tagebuch in Bildern (Toyo Bunko copy La-161)
photos.why: Commons category 谐奇趣; brick pier and columns seen across a sheet of water, the pond of Ohlmer P0186. Pond of P0186, pier and columns of P0200, cluster of P0305 at right.
photos.attribution: Alfons von Mumm, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.camera_note: From the south shore of the 谐奇趣 pond, as P0186. +-30 m.
photos.visible: column clusters of the east octagon at right edge

photos.title: 谐奇趣北面 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 二 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: Printed title. The double stair is what the plan draws as XY01-N02/N03 ; the two pavilions show small behind the wings. The fountain before the stair has no id.
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.visible: east octagon, upper parts, small, at left behind the terrace

photos.title: Gezicht op de ruïnes van een deel van het Zomerpaleis, Gezicht op een water bij Peking, Gezicht op de weg naar het Zomerpaleis en Gezicht op een deel van het Zomerpaleis
photos.creator: unknown, autotypes in a book
photos.why: Top-left plate: octagonal pavilion with columns, as P0185. Bottom-right plate: arched gate with two niches, as XY05 east in P0175. Bottom-right plate is not the east gate of 养雀笼: flat-headed door gap between two oval cartouches, piers and balustraded parapet, the east end of 谐奇趣 as P0188 and P0165. XY05 east has an arch and two niches (P0175, P0192).
photos.visible: top-left plate, printed PAVILLON EUROPÉEN: octagon, ground storey columns, framed panel, upper storey with cartouches
